input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, extend it to the whole Agreement, add a meaningful floor, exclude indirect damages, and place indemnities/confidentiality outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and applicable to the whole Agreement rather than only Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, since as drafted TrueLink is capped while our liability (including the broad Section 12(a) indemnity) is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap; we can accept a straight 12 months' fees cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER THIS SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
